---
title: Garlic and Parsley
id: MAR-0059
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 15
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of pecorino cheese
- 20 g of parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste pepper
## Method
1. Wash the parsley, dry it and remove the stems.
2. Peel the garlic and chop it with the parsley.
3. Grease 4 small terracotta molds with the oil, arrange the pecorino slices in them and sprinkle each slice with the chopped parsley.
4. Place under the oven grill until the cheese begins to melt.
5. Finish with a grind of pepper and serve.
